description: This file defines constants, enums, and classes related to 5G SSB (Synchronization Signal Block) properties, including bandwidth, periodicity, pattern cases, subcarrier spacing, and resource block offsets, following 3GPP specifications.

classes.name: ssb_offset_to_pointA
classes.description: Represents the frequency offset between Point A and the lowest subcarrier of the SS/PBCH block, bounded between 0 and 2199 resource blocks.

classes.name: ssb_subcarrier_offset
classes.description: Represents the offset from subcarrier zero in the common resource block to the SS/PBCH subcarrier, with validation based on frequency range.

methods.name: ssb_periodicity_to_value
methods.description: Converts ssb_periodicity enum to its integer value in milliseconds.

methods.name: to_subcarrier_spacing
methods.description: Returns the subcarrier spacing corresponding to a given ssb_pattern_case.

methods.name: to_string
methods.description: Returns a string label for a given ssb_pattern_case.

methods.name: to_frequency_range
methods.description: Returns the frequency range (FR1 or FR2) for a given ssb_pattern_case.
